items.ai_first_turn_fi: Ladies and gentlemen, distinguished panelists. We have heard presentations from our colleagues from Brazil, who emphasized the importance of preserving the Amazon and the need for developed countries to provide financial support. Our Chinese colleague highlighted the challenges of balancing economic growth with environmental protection in developing economies. Now I'd like to ask our Finnish panelist: As a representative of a Nordic country that has positioned itself as a climate leader, how do you see the responsibility of wealthy nations like yours? Is it fair to expect developing countries to follow the same strict environmental regulations when your own prosperity was built on fossil fuels? And concretely, what more should countries like Finland do to support global climate justice? Please respond in Finnish, as this is a Finnish language seminar track.
